explanation: A skilled Israelite craftsman chosen by God to lead the work of building the tabernacle.
Another skilled Israelite craftsman who was chosen by God to help Besalel build the tabernacle.
The ability to use knowledge and experience in a wise and insightful way, given by God to selected individuals.
Professional skill within a specific trade or art, such as carpentry, jewelry design, weaving, and engraving.
The seventh day of the week, a holy day for rest and worship, which God commanded the Israelites to keep holy.
An agreement between God and people, often accompanied by promises and conditions from both parties.
The act of breaking an agreement, covenant, or promise, leading to consequences and punishment from God.
